title: Maximum separation time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time after the player starts moving when the distance between them is greatest, which should be 3 s.

title: Maximum separation distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum distance between the player and the ball, which should be 11.5 m.

title: Catch-up time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total time from the player's start until catching the ball, which should be 7 s.

title: Ball speed at catch-up
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed of the ball at the moment the player catches it, which should be 1 m/s.

title: Relative velocity condition
description: Important: Applies the condition that maximum separation occurs when the player's speed equals the ball's speed relative to the ground.

title: Kinematic equations setup
description: Important: Sets up correct displacement equations for both the ball (decelerating) and the player (accelerating then constant speed) to find catch-up time.

title: Player's motion phases
description: Important: Correctly accounts for the player's acceleration phase (0 to 6 s) and constant-speed phase (after 6 s).

title: Ball's stopping time
description: Optional: Calculates the time it would take for the ball to stop on its own (10 s) as a check.

title: Ignoring the 1s delay
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the 1-second delay between the kick and the player starting the chase in time variables.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for the ball's deceleration in kinematic equations (e.g., treating it as acceleration).
